name: Lunar south polar terrain sector
coordinate_convention: Lunar planetocentric latitude, east-positive longitude (Moon 2015 sphere, IAU 30100). Never drawn on Earth.
body_figure: Sphere, radius 1737400 m (as declared in the source GeoTIFF CRS, south polar stereographic)
crop_note: Raw crop is 40 km x 40 km in the native polar stereographic grid. Person 1 builds the 20 km window after derivatives.
limitations: Prototype comparison sector, not an officially selected lunar-base location.
Terrain only: illumination, temperature and ice are not represented.
